title: No subsidised LPG refill for non-eKYC households from October 1; only 5 kg and 10 kg at market price
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
verified_by: The Hindu bureau report, article fetched and fact-matched 2026-10-02
bullets_en: No subsidised LPG cylinder for households that have not done eKYC, from October 1.
They can buy only 5 kg or 10 kg cylinders at market price, without subsidy.
A 14.2 kg subsidised cylinder costs ₹994 in Hyderabad; the 5 kg refill is ₹846.50.
Pending and prepaid orders of such households were cancelled from October 1.
About 11 lakh LPG users in Telangana are yet to complete eKYC, say distributors.
bullets_ur: 1 October se jin gharon ne eKYC nahi ki, unhe subsidised LPG cylinder nahi milega.
Aise grahak sirf 5 kg ya 10 kg cylinder market price par khareed sakte hain, bina subsidy.
Hyderabad mein 14.2 kg subsidised cylinder ₹994 aur 5 kg refill ₹846.50 ka hai.
In gharon ke pending aur prepaid orders 1 October se cancel kar diye gaye.
Telangana mein taqreeban 11 lakh LPG users ke eKYC baqi hain, distributors ke mutabiq.
